title: BCA Jing Sima：中国AI公司尚未盈利，全球投资者需谨慎
speaker: Jing Sima

segments.en: yeah well I think there are main two main reasons one is a lot of those companies you know they're selling this AI story but you know we don't see monetization yet we don't see profitability yet
segments.zh: 主要有两个原因：一是很多公司都在讲AI故事，但我们还没有看到变现和盈利能力

segments.en: compared to especially compared to some of the Korean companies Taiwanese companies the US companies especially so in relative terms I think for global investors Chinese AI companies are up and coming but they're still emerging they're not there yet
segments.zh: 与韩国、台湾、美国公司相比，中国AI公司还在崛起中，尚未成熟

segments.en: and the other thing is I do believe we're in the late cycle a lot of indicators are shown in signs of a typical late cycle in catags so I think take AI catags is a pretty pretty certain story but on the rate of change basis you know this year we see huge catags next year we're going to see catags in absolute levels but rate of change basis we may see a moderation
segments.zh: 另一个原因是我们处于周期后期，AI资本支出虽然确定，但增速可能放缓

segments.en: okay um is that going to play out in China though because the the AI plays in China have largely moved along the domestic story not so much the global catags story I just wonder how you two those two themes intersect well yeah they are you're right they're two two themes
segments.zh: 中国的AI行情主要跟随国内故事，而非全球资本支出故事，这两个主题如何交叉？
